findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_audit · Private data: social_search, security_audit, token_alpha, domain_intel, wallet_profiler, defi_yields, token_due_diligence, b2b_company_dossier, whale_alpha_radar, llm_chat_completions, buy_prepaid_pass, x402_ping · Public sink: domain_intel · Destructive: compliance_check, llm_chat_completions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_audit · Private data: social_search, security_audit, token_alpha, domain_intel, wallet_profiler, defi_yields, token_due_diligence, b2b_company_dossier, whale_alpha_radar, llm_chat_completions, buy_prepaid_pass, x402_ping · Public sink: domain_intel · Destructive: compliance_check, llm_chat_completions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
